headline: Both chambers gaveled in for a quick pro forma session Monday as Congress prepares to reconvene Thursday morning!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened briefly in pro forma session on Monday, August 24 at 12:30 p.m. and adjourned within seconds. The chamber will return to pro forma proceedings on Thursday.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met Monday, August 24 for a brief session lasting just three minutes. Eleven public bills and four resolutions were introduced, but no votes or quorum calls took place. The chamber will reconvene in pro forma session Thursday.
